cards.text: Friend, the Sabbath is over. At dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary head out to see the tomb where Jesus was laid. Two women, early morning, quiet road.
Quiet road for about two seconds. Suddenly, a GREAT earthquake.

cards.question: A great earthquake shakes everything as the women head to the tomb. What's behind it?

answers.text: An angel of the Lord came down from heaven
The guards were breaking open the seal
The disciples were moving the stone away

cards.question: The angel rolls away the stone from the tomb and then ___ on it.

cards.text: He rolls away a GREAT stone, then sits on it like it's a porch chair. His appearance is like lightning, and his clothes are white as snow.

cards.question: The guards posted at the tomb see the angel. What happens to them?

answers.text: They tremble and become like dead men
They draw their swords and charge him
They run off to the city to find Pilate

cards.text: Then the angel speaks to the women: 'Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.' The guards did NOT get that speech.

cards.question: The women came looking for Jesus. What does the angel tell them about Him?

answers.text: He has risen just as He said
His disciples took His body away
Joseph moved His body in the night

cards.question: The angel invites the women to come and see the place where Jesus lay.

cards.text: Then the angel gives the women a job: go quickly and tell His disciples that He has risen from the dead. Biggest news you've ever carried, and you've got to run it across town. No pressure.

cards.question: The angel says Jesus is going ahead of the disciples into ___, and there they will see Him.
After an earthquake, a shining angel and the news that Jesus has risen, the women hurry away from the tomb in fear and great ___.

cards.text: So they RUN to tell His disciples. Then suddenly, right there on the way, somebody meets them.

cards.question: The women are running to tell the disciples the news. Who suddenly meets them on the way?
Jesus meets the women and says, 'Greetings!' What do they do?

answers.text: They grasp His feet and worship Him
They run back to the empty tomb
They stand back and stay silent

cards.text: Jesus tells them, 'Do not be afraid,' just like the angel did. And He sends a message to the disciples, calling them 'My brothers.'

cards.question: Jesus tells the women that His brothers, the disciples, will see Him in Jerusalem.

cards.text: While the women are on their way, some of the guards go into the city and report to the chief priests all that had happened. Imagine giving THAT report to your boss: 'So... there was an earthquake, a guy who looked like lightning, and then we kind of... lay down.'

cards.question: The chief priests meet with the elders and form a plan. What do they give the soldiers?
The chief priests were already worried about the disciples taking the body. What story do they tell the soldiers to spread?

answers.text: His disciples stole Him while we slept
Pilate's men moved Him in the night
Joseph took Him away before dawn

cards.text: Think about that story, friend. You were ASLEEP, but you know exactly who did it? That's me waking up from a nap saying, I was out cold the whole time, but I KNOW who ate the chocolate chips.

cards.question: The chief priests promise the soldiers that if the report reaches the governor, they'll keep them out of trouble.
The guards turn down the chief priests' money and tell everyone the truth.

cards.text: So the guards take the money and do as they were instructed. And Matthew says this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day.
Meanwhile, the eleven disciples go to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated. And there He is.

cards.question: When the eleven disciples see Jesus on the mountain, every one of them worships Him with no doubt at all.

cards.text: They worship Him, but some doubt. Friend, if you'd told me back in the junk drawer that I'd end up renewed on a gold base, I'd have doubted TOO.

cards.question: Jesus comes to the eleven on the mountain and speaks. What does He say has been given to Him?

answers.text: All authority in heaven and on earth
A throne in the city of Jerusalem
Rest from all His work on earth

cards.text: Because of that, Jesus sends them out. Therefore, He says, go and make disciples.

cards.question: Jesus has all authority in heaven and on earth. Who does He send the eleven to make disciples of?
To make disciples, Jesus tells the eleven to ___ them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, and ___ them to obey all He commanded.

cards.text: Then Jesus ends with a promise. And it's a BIG one.

cards.question: Jesus sends the eleven out to all nations. How long does He promise to be with them?

answers.text: Always even to the end of the age

cards.text: Friend, I know what it's like to sit in the dark thinking everybody forgot you. Jesus doesn't send His disciples out and wave goodbye. He says He's with them always, even to the end of the age.

findings.problem: Card 4 already asked about the angel rolling away the stone and sitting on it. This card retells that same beat before reaching v3, so most of it is a recap. It also calls it a 'GREAT stone,' which Matthew 28:2 doesn't say. That detail comes from Matthew 27:60, and the card gives no reference for it.
'GREAT stone' adds a word Matthew 28:2 doesn't use. The fact comes from outside the passage (Matthew 27:60) and has no reference.

rule.text: References. Every Bible fact he states carries its reference.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'They run off to the city to find Pilate' is partly true later in the passage: some of the guards do go into the city (Matthew 28:11). A baker could argue it's half right. Use a wrong answer with no overlap with the passage.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.

findings.problem: Stop 1's humor stays mild ('porch chair,' 'The guards did NOT get that speech,' 'No pressure'). Most story cards read like a pleasant dad narrating, and nothing in the stop is laugh-out-loud. Stop 2 does better with the nap joke.

rule.text: If a line reads like a nice dad being pleasant, push it further.

findings.problem: The question opens with 'The chief priests were already worried about the disciples taking the body.' That fact comes from Matthew 27:62-64, outside the passage, and has no reference. The card only cites Matthew 28:13.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: This card is only a joke about v13, which card 3 already covered. It tells no new part of the passage, so the joke isn't riding along on a card that moves things forward. Fold the joke into a card that carries the next beat (v14), or into card 7.

rule.text: Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.

findings.problem: Card 6 already answered that the guards take the money and go along with the plan. This card's first sentence repeats that before giving the new detail about the account being circulated.
'And there He is' tells the disciples seeing Jesus, which is Matthew 28:17. The card only cites Matthew 28:16. It should cite Matthew 28:16-17.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

findings.problem: 'They worship Him, but some doubt' repeats what card 9 just answered. The rest of the card is a joke, and it tells no new part of the passage.
The right answer 'All nations' (2 words) is much shorter than the wrong answers 'Only the people of Israel' and 'The towns of Galilee,' so it stands out.

rule.text: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone.

findings.problem: Card 16 already answered that Jesus promises to be with them always, even to the end of the age. This closing card restates that promise and tells no new part of the passage.
